explanation: Antonio Stradivari worked in Cremona, Italy, for decades. Several hundred of his instruments survive, mostly violins, along with violas, cellos and even a few guitars.

claims.text: Most surviving instruments made by Antonio Stradivari are violins.
Stradivari did not make pianos, flutes or trumpets.
Antonio Stradivari worked in Cremona, Italy.
Several hundred Stradivari instruments survive, including violins, violas, cellos and a few guitars.
